summary: CREBAIN: a desktop and native simulation environment for drone sensing, deterministic dynamics, sensor fusion and an optional NCP body. AGENTS.md is the operating contract; this index restates its operational facts for tools.

entry_documents.role: index of the complete contract set

delivery.merge: Commit in a separate worktree from origin/main, run the applicable complete gate, then push to main.
delivery.attribution: no AI attribution, co-author trailers or generated-by lines

gates.command: bun run check:docs-visuals && bun run format:check && git diff --check

gates.when: agent-index.json or a path it names changes
a pinned configuration file changes, such as package.json, bun.lock or bun.nix
NCP manifests, locks or normative prose change
native environment, dynamics, Rust, IPC, transport, models, scenes, fusion or cross-cutting behavior changes

generated.regenerate: update the sha256 of each changed pinned file in crebain_configuration_artifacts; keep captured fields historical

frozen.reason: hash-verified upstream archives; record manifest-only changes in PROVENANCE.json; bun run check:vendor-compat checks them
retained audit inputs and review records

shared.reason: shared with Engram (Paper2Brain) with its lock; change only together with Engram's copy
binds the restricted Engram host with its lock; change only in a coordinated Engram host update

ecosystem.relation: pins the 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate 2819dae for the optional body and sensor applications
advisory producer and drone study fixture
Engram embedding and shared host vector
